<thought>We have the template ID 1914384 and its mapped reaction. The left‑hand side (precursor) after removing atom‑mapping and stereochemistry is a single molecule  
`CC(c1ccccc1)=CCH2CH2CH2C(=O)C(F)(F)F`.  
The right‑hand side (product) is the cyclized molecule  
`CC(c1ccccc1)C1CCCCC1(O)C(F)(F)F`.  
Thus the retrosynthesis route consists of the target molecule (product) as the root, a single reaction node using template 1914384, and one precursor molecule (the left‑hand side).  
We construct the JSON accordingly and then validate it with `verify_route`.
